## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the feature spec, if applicable.

## Verification

Record commands and results, acceptance-criteria coverage, and browser checks for
UI changes. State anything not run and why.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are covered; remaining gaps are stated.
- [ ] Relevant permissions, validation, and failure paths are checked.
- [ ] Database changes and deployment implications are described, if applicable.
- [ ] Required checks pass; any failures or unavailable checks are explained.
- [ ] Spec and product documentation reflect the delivered behaviour.
